title: Judgement on the developer's follow-up: it should be fixed in this sprint, not deferred
description: Judgement on the developer's follow-up: it should be fixed in this sprint, not deferred. It is a regression this sprint introduces. Question-kind rules now run inside deserialization, so any rule violation (11 score levels, one choice, descriptions count, an unknown kind) is a serde Data error. `request_json_error` maps every Data error to 'request JSON must contain a questions array', which is false and misleading for a document that does have a questions array. It also masks hints that used to be specific: `{"choices":[]}` on a choice question used to reach 'question q choices are empty' (questions.rs:104), and that message is now unreachable from caller JSON. The generic text was chosen so raw values are not echoed (the test at caller.rs:116 asserts that). The rule messages from payload.rs:233-278 contain only the question id, kind and counts, so they are safe to show.
